Interface DoubleDeque

All Superinterfaces:
DoubleCollection, DoubleContainer, Iterable<DoubleCursor>
All Known Implementing Classes:
DoubleArrayDeque
@Generated(date="2026-09-20T20:45:48+0200", value="KTypeDeque.java") public interface DoubleDeque extends DoubleCollection
A linear collection that supports element insertion and removal at both ends.
